M9-T-G08.I: passed, actual file service/native/chunk reader/model and scoped controller; OS shell seam mocked
M9-T-G08.A: passed, actual packaged UI pointer/keyboard; default browser independently observed for G08
M9-T-G08.actual: Same-directory/parent PNG with Chinese/space names decoded 1x1; outside-root image denied. Internal target#fragment opened correct file and same-file anchor kept original document. Explicit external link reached default Chrome at the exact localhost test URL (plus favicon only); CUA independently verified/closed the page. I covers real related-file and resource resolution, foreign-owner/root denial, and scoped openWebLink positive/invalid/credential rejection with mocked OS seam.

M9-T-G09.I: passed, actual file service/native/chunk reader/model and scoped controller; OS shell seam mocked
M9-T-G09.A: passed, actual packaged UI pointer/keyboard; default browser independently observed for G08
M9-T-G09.actual: Frontmatter, GFM table, checked/unchecked tasks, highlighted code, short KaTeX and native Mermaid image displayed. 60-term complex formula exceeds the frozen markup budget and explicitly reports source fallback; entire formula retained including x_59. Source/document round trips preserve exact disk bytes, identity and timestamps. CodeMirror visible source uses LF-normalized text; disk bytes retain original CRLF.

M9-T-G10.I: passed, actual file service/native/chunk reader/model and scoped controller; OS shell seam mocked
M9-T-G10.A: passed, actual packaged UI pointer/keyboard; default browser independently observed for G08
M9-T-G10.actual: Authored SVG with script/onload/foreignObject/remote image remained an image resource, decoded 40x30 with green rect; no script sentinel or implicit HTTP request, no authored SVG script/foreignObject in App DOM. Complete source accessible and image/source/image roundtrip preserves disk bytes.

iterations.appR1: Driver required KaTeX for over-budget long formula despite visible explicit source fallback. No product failure; preserved original long formula and added short supported formula, checked fallback + exact source.
iterations.nativeR1: Test called contextless scoped IPC stub directly; rejected requires IPC sender. Corrected test to register actual RPC handlers with synthetic trusted event.
iterations.final: All original branches pass; no product source edit or rebuild.

boundaries: Only G08/G09/G10; no complete Markdown/SVG visual/theme or other semantic-feature claim.
Long-formula source fallback is an explicit existing renderer limit, not a claim of full visual formula rendering.
No implicit remote fetch; only explicit user-like link click opens this test localhost browser URL.
No model/CLI launched; old r6 unsent input and AIS directory untouched.
